description: This file defines a mock class 'FrontPanelMock' implementing the 'IFrontPanel' interface for testing purposes. It includes mock methods for various front panel control functionalities such as configuring, setting brightness, controlling LEDs, and power lights, primarily used in unit testing scenarios.

classes.name: FrontPanelMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing the IFrontPanel interface for testing front panel functionalities.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Mocks configuration of the front panel with a service shell.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of brightness level for a given index.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of a list of supported front panel lights.

methods.name: PowerLedOff
methods.description: Mocks turning off a power LED identified by index.

methods.name: PowerLedOn
methods.description: Mocks turning on a power LED identified by index.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Mocks setting blinking behavior for front panel indicators.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Mocks setting the brightness for a specific indicator.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Mocks setting LED indicator with specified color and brightness values.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying for a specific interface by ID.
